question: What time does the building open?
answer: The building opens at 6 am on weekdays. [1]

sources.content:
FACILITIES GUIDE - BUILDING ACCESS
Access cards are issued by reception on the ground floor.
The building is open from 6am to 8pm on weekdays.
After hours entry requires a card and a PIN.

claims.text: The building opens at 6 am on weekdays. [1]

grade.completenessNote: Gives the opening time; the closing time was not asked.
